reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relative LINE NUMBER clause that is not the first in its group prints on the group's previous print line + integer-2 (integer-2 zero = the same line, overprinted), and a first relative clause is placed by the presentation rules tables for its group type (RH HEADING + integer - 1, PH after an RH at LINE-COUNTER + integer, body per §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR4, RF at FOOTING + integer or the PF's final LINE-COUNTER + integer, unpaged LINE-COUNTER + integer).

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002: refuses a relative first LINE in a page footing (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9) and integers over three significant digits (SR1); neither changes GR4's placement

reader.edition-search: SubsequentTarget, RelativeValue, PresentLine and FirstLineTarget consult no edition (read whole); grep for Edition/DialectBehaviors in ReportWriter.cs finds no switch on line placement.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (placement); the binder's 85-only SR9 refusal keeps a relative first PF line out of 85, which 2023 places from FOOTING

reader.notes: SubsequentTarget is LINE-COUNTER + integer-2, and PresentLine sets LINE-COUNTER to each printed line, so it is the group's previous print line; a zero relative is merged into the held-back image (Overprint). The PH first-line rule rests on the reconstructed folio XIII-30 (low confidence, kb/Work PB4952); the probe's PH line matches that reconstruction.

refuter.evidence: SubsequentTarget is LINE-COUNTER + integer-2, and PresentLine sets LINE-COUNTER to every printed line, so LINE-COUNTER is always the previous print line. E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-234/r2ln.cob (run r2ln-001): A1@5, a blank-image line at 8 (PLUS 3), A3@9; second DE A1@10, blank 13, A3@14. A print line with blank content still counts as the previous print line. In the A R group, B1@20, B2@22, then PLUS 0 overprints on 22 ('B2@22    b0@22'), then B3@24. In E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-234/r1sav.cob R3 (no PF), the RF's first relative line goes to FOOTING 25 + 2 = 27 (§1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR3b), PLUS 0 overprints on 27 and PLUS 2 lands on 29. Refusal half at 85: c7 (LINE inside a LINE entry, §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR2) and c8 (absolute after relative, SR3) give COBOL2199. c1 ('+'), c2 (bare NEXT PAGE), c3 (PLUS ... ON NEXT PAGE) and c4 (multiple LINE) give COBOL0900. cite.py: `OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR4  ... the text is in GR4`; `OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR2  ... the text is in SR2`.
